newsitem.title: USA: Health Power sees Q3, Q4 gains.
newsitem.headline: Health Power sees Q3, Q4 gains.

text.p: Health Power Inc said that barring unforeseen circumstances, it expects its operating results on a consolidated basis will be profitable during the third and fourth quarters of the year.

The company said among the reasons for its optimism was the Ohio General Assembly's passage of the state's budget, in which its subsidiary, Health Power HMO Inc received an increase, effective July 1, of about 4 percent in the capitation rate.
The rate is paid under a contract with the Ohio Department of Human Services for ADC Medicaid recipients enrolled in the HMO unit.

Thomas Beaty, president, said the company's return to profitability is also being driven by a plan to turn around its HMO unit, the continued profitable operations of its workers' compensation subsidiary, CompManagement Inc and the expected contributions from CompManagement Health Systems Inc, a unit of CompManagement.
The company said its HMO unit's contract with the Ohio state agency expires on December 31.
